races.paceDynamic: Top Biller will lead uncontested with Alashos, Bated Breeze, Grand Citadel, Anglesey Lad and Apple's Angel sitting prominent but none applying early pressure. This creates a steady, sustainable gallop through the first half before the prominent brigade engage from 3f out. The large field of hold-up horses will face a wall of traffic in the straight as 20+ runners funnel into Brighton's narrow home stretch. This race shape strongly favours the early positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scores
scenarios.trigger: If Top Biller gets an easy lead and quickens off steady fractions
scenarios.body: The lone front-runner capitalizes on soft sectionals while the field gets stuck behind each other in a cavalry charge finish. Early positioning proves decisive on a narrow track with 25 runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace builds from 3f out as prominent horses engage
scenarios.body: One of the forward placed runners times their challenge perfectly while maintaining a clear passage. The leader weakens but the hold-up brigade still can't get through the traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and gaps appear in the straight
scenarios.body: A well-positioned hold-up runner gets a dream run through as others get shuffled back. Von Krolock or Manhattan Chute benefit from tactical pace and superior turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Upset
scenarios.trigger: If severe interference creates a lottery finish among stragglers
scenarios.body: The race becomes completely fragmented with fallers or hampering allowing a rank outsider to pick up the pieces. Racing luck trumps form and positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Tam Lin is the only confirmed front runner in this 21-runner field and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate terms at a comfortable gallop. The prominent runners Kondratiev Wave, Scenario, Man Is King and Huntly Lodge will track closely behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Volendam, Banksman, and Clipsham Noble will be seeking room in the pack. With such a strong pace bias toward one leader and minimal early speed, this sets up perfectly for horses that can sit handy and kick, while the many hold-up horses will struggle to find clear runs in a big field from what will likely be a slowly-run race. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the lone leader and pounce.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tam Lin Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Tam Lin gets an easy lead with no pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: He dictates a steady pace and the field becomes strung out, making it hard for hold-up horses to close ground effectively. The lack of pace pressure allows him to quicken when it matters while those tracking him get first run on the many hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: They get the ideal trip sitting behind the uncontested leader and can time their challenge to perfection as the hold-up horses get caught in traffic. The steady pace suits their style while giving them positional advantage over the crowded pack behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A few hold-up horses with the best turn of foot like Volendam or Banksman find racing room and exploit the lack of genuine pace. The slow tempo plays into their hands despite the tactical disadvantage of being so far back in a big field.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with horses getting hampered and checked throughout the field. Early positioned horses who avoid trouble benefit regardless of their natural running style, while late runners get completely shut out.
